title: Lumina Heights, Ikoyi
description:
An architectural masterpiece perched above the serene waters of Ikoyi, Lumina Heights redefines luxury living in Lagos. Floor-to-ceiling glazing floods every room with natural light, while Italian Carrara marble finishes and solid oak herringbone flooring create an interior of rare distinction. The expansive living and dining areas flow seamlessly to a wraparound terrace with panoramic lagoon and city views.

Designed by award-winning architecture studio Lagos+, this residence is a rare convergence of art and function. The chef's kitchen is fitted with Miele appliances, Boffi cabinetry, and a marble island large enough for serious entertaining. Each of the four en-suite bedrooms is a private retreat, with the master suite occupying the entire south wing — complete with a dressing room and a spa-style bathroom with a freestanding soaking tub.

The building's amenities are equally impressive: a rooftop infinity pool, a fully equipped gym, a residents' lounge, and round-the-clock concierge service. The smart home system controls lighting, climate, security, and AV from a single interface — or remotely from anywhere in the world. This is Ikoyi living at its absolute pinnacle.

title: Meridian Villa, Lekki Phase 1
description:
A sprawling six-bedroom villa set behind high rendered walls on the most coveted stretch of Admiralty Way in Lekki Phase 1. Conceived as a private compound, the property is anchored by a 2,000 sqft main pavilion that opens to a resort-style pool courtyard. Landscaped gardens, a koi pond, and mature tropical trees create a sanctuary of calm within the city.

Inside, no detail has been overlooked. The chef's kitchen features Wolf range cookers and a walk-in pantry. The ground floor hosts a formal dining room for 20, a home cinema with Dolby Atmos sound, and a climate-controlled wine cellar with capacity for over 1,000 bottles. An adjoining wellness suite houses a steam room, sauna, and massage room. All six bedrooms are en-suite, with the master wing occupying a private upper-floor annexe.

The estate is fully walled with a gated motor court accommodating six vehicles, a staff quarters block, and a 200KVA generator plant ensuring uninterrupted power. Smart home technology by Crestron controls everything from gate access to cinema presets. Meridian Villa represents the gold standard of family compound living in Lagos.

title: Victoria Crown, Victoria Island
address: 8 Adeola Odeku Street, Victoria Island, Lagos
description:
Situated in the heart of Victoria Island's prestigious business and diplomatic quarter, Victoria Crown offers premium three-bedroom apartments tailored for the discerning executive. The interiors are a seamless blend of contemporary design and practical luxury — neutral palettes, brushed brass hardware, and engineered wood floors that reward long-term tenants who value a refined home environment.

The open-plan living and dining space is flanked by a fully fitted kitchen with integrated Bosch appliances, perfect for casual hosting on weekday evenings. The master bedroom features a generous walk-in wardrobe, a rain shower, and a freestanding bathtub. Two additional bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms cater comfortably to family or a home office setup.

Residents of Victoria Crown enjoy 24/7 concierge, a rooftop swimming pool with a sundeck, a fitness suite, and two dedicated parking bays. The building is served by a 200A inverter and diesel backup, ensuring seamless power at all hours. With landmark offices, top-tier restaurants, and the waterfront all within walking distance, this is undoubtedly the most convenient address on Victoria Island.

title: Asokoro Manor, Abuja
description:
Nestled in the heart of Asokoro's diplomatic enclave — the most private and sought-after residential address in the FCT — Asokoro Manor is a statement of understated power. Designed by Abuja-based studio Form+Space, the five-bedroom residence draws on modernist principles: clean lines, generous volumes, and a material palette of fair-faced concrete, natural stone, and warm teak.

The ground floor is conceived as a series of interconnected living spaces that open to a wide rear terrace and a landscaped swimming pool area. A formal sitting room, family lounge, study, and dining pavilion offer flexibility for both private family life and official entertaining. The professional kitchen is equipped to restaurant standard, with a separate service kitchen adjacent to the staff quarters.

Each of the five bedrooms is a suite unto itself, with the master bedroom offering a private balcony, dressing room, and a bathroom clad entirely in Verde Guatemala marble. A Savant smart home system governs lighting scenes, climate control, and security across all four levels. Located minutes from the State House, the National Assembly complex, and the city's premier diplomatic missions, Asokoro Manor is Abuja's most coveted address for those who demand the very best.

title: Banana Island Penthouse
description:
There are rare properties, and then there is this — the crown jewel of Banana Island. Occupying the entire top floor of Lagos's most exclusive residential address, this full-floor penthouse is one of fewer than ten residences of its calibre on the African continent. The 9,200 sqft of internal living space spills out to a further 3,400 sqft of wraparound terrace, offering 360-degree views of the Lagos Lagoon, the Atlantic horizon, and the city skyline.

The interiors were created by internationally acclaimed designer Julien Boulet — a marriage of African artisanship and Parisian modernism. Custom hand-knotted Berber rugs, bespoke joinery by Lagos craftsmen, and art-gallery lighting installations define the principal rooms. The kitchen is a professional chef's playground, with La Cornue ranges, Sub-Zero refrigeration, and a climate-controlled wine room for 2,000 bottles. An internal lift connects all five suites, the entertainment floor, and the roof terrace above.

The roof terrace itself is unlike anything in West Africa: a private infinity pool, an outdoor kitchen with a wood-fired grill, a helipad, and a dedicated sundeck with ocean views. Building services include a 24/7 concierge, valet parking, a private spa, and dedicated security personnel. Banana Island Penthouse is not merely a home — it is a landmark.

title: Maitama Townhouse, Abuja
description:
Set along one of Maitama's most tranquil tree-lined streets, this four-bedroom townhouse strikes the ideal balance between contemporary design and relaxed family living. The ground floor's open-plan configuration — spanning a sitting room, dining area, and modern kitchen — creates a sociable space that works equally well for weekday family routines and weekend gatherings. Sliding glass doors lead directly to a private garden courtyard, where mature trees and a pergola create a serene outdoor dining space.

Upstairs, four generously proportioned bedrooms each benefit from built-in wardrobes and en-suite bathrooms tiled in large-format porcelain. The master bedroom opens onto a private balcony with garden views. A dedicated study on the mezzanine level provides a quiet workspace. The property also features a self-contained BQ (Boys' Quarters) suitable for domestic staff or extended family.

The townhouse sits within a small gated development of seven units, sharing a cooperative security arrangement with a gateman and CCTV coverage of all entry points. Solar panels offset daytime power needs, supplemented by a 20KVA generator for evening coverage. Maitama's diplomatic quarter, premium restaurants, and Transcorp Hilton are all within a short drive, making this an ideal base for foreign missions and senior executives relocating to Abuja.

title: Oniru Estate, Lagos
address: Oniru Private Estate, Victoria Island Extension, Lagos
description:
Located within the exclusive Oniru Private Estate on Victoria Island Extension, this well-appointed three-bedroom apartment offers a refined lifestyle that is rarely achievable at this price point in Lagos. The residence occupies a prime corner position on the fifth floor, with cross-ventilation and natural light flowing through large casement windows that frame views toward the Atlantic Ocean to the south and the Victoria Island skyline to the west.

The interiors are clean, modern, and move-in ready, with freshly installed porcelain tile flooring, recessed lighting throughout, and a kitchen fitted with quality Nigerian-made cabinetry and granite worktops. All three bedrooms are generously proportioned, with the master bedroom enjoying an en-suite bathroom with a rain shower and bathtub. A covered balcony off the living room provides an ideal outdoor perch for evenings and weekend mornings.

The Oniru Private Estate is one of Lagos's most desirable gated communities — quiet, green, and extremely well-managed. Residents benefit from round-the-clock security, a community swimming pool, ample visitor parking, and consistent power supply from the estate's own transformer and communal generator. Moments from Oniru Beach, Nu Metro Cinemas, and some of Lagos's finest waterfront restaurants, this apartment represents a sound lifestyle investment.

title: Guzape Residence, Abuja
description:
The Guzape District is fast becoming Abuja's most talked-about residential address — and this four-bedroom residence makes a compelling case for why. Positioned on an elevated plot with uninterrupted views of Aso Rock to the north, the property was designed to capture that outlook at every turn: a double-height entrance atrium, a glass-sided staircase, and wide rear terracing all frame the iconic granite inselberg in the distance.

The interior design is warm and grounded — blonde wood joinery, terracotta accents, and linen drapery reference the natural tones of the surrounding plateau without sacrificing modernity. The ground floor comprises an open-plan living and dining room, a separate family room, a study, and a kitchen fitted with Electrolux appliances and a centre island with seating. Upstairs, four generous en-suite bedrooms are arranged around a sky-lit landing.

The property is sold with a valid Certificate of Occupancy and is serviced by a borehole, 200A solar inverter system, and a 40KVA standby generator. A self-contained BQ and a covered double garage complete the picture. The Guzape District offers exceptional appreciation prospects — well-serviced, rapidly developing, and increasingly popular with Abuja's professional class — making this residence both an ideal home and a sound capital investment.

title: Camps Bay Mansion, Cape Town
address: Camps Bay Drive, Camps Bay, Cape Town, South Africa
description:
Positioned directly on the Camps Bay beachfront with the Twelve Apostles mountain range rising behind it, this five-bedroom residence is one of the most sought-after private homes on the African continent. Floor-to-ceiling glazing runs the full width of the ocean-facing elevation, dissolving the boundary between the interior and the Atlantic beyond. At sunrise and sunset, the light that fills this home is simply without parallel.

The interior was conceived by a Cape Town-based studio whose work has appeared in Architectural Digest Africa. The ground floor is a single, sweeping open-plan space: a living pavilion, a formal dining area, and a chef's kitchen equipped with Gaggenau appliances and a scullery behind. A series of bi-fold doors open the entire south wall to a terrace, an outdoor dining area, and a heated infinity pool that appears to pour directly into the ocean. Five en-suite bedrooms are arranged across two upper levels, each designed to maximise the mountain and sea views. The master suite occupies the full top floor and includes a private wraparound deck.

Camps Bay is Cape Town's most glamorous residential and leisure address, home to some of Southern Africa's finest restaurants, beach clubs, and boutiques. The property is sold fully furnished with original artwork included. This is a rare and genuine trophy asset in one of the world's great coastal cities.

title: East Legon Mansion, Accra
address: Ambassadorial Enclave, East Legon, Accra, Ghana
description:
Set within the Ambassadorial Enclave of East Legon, Accra's most coveted residential district, this six-bedroom mansion is a masterclass in West African luxury at its most assured. Developed by one of Ghana's foremost construction groups and finished to an international standard that would be credible in any major world city, the property sits on a 1.2-acre plot behind a gated motor court and is surrounded by professionally landscaped grounds.

The main residence unfolds across three levels. The ground floor is anchored by a grand entrance gallery with a double-height atrium, a 40-seat formal reception room, a private study, a cinema room, and a kitchen and catering wing that operates independently for large events. The first floor houses four guest suites, each with a private bathroom and balcony. The second floor is reserved entirely for the master wing, a 2,200 sqft private apartment within the house, comprising a sitting room, dressing suite, a spa bathroom with sauna, and a private terrace overlooking the pool garden.

The grounds include a resort-style swimming pool, a shaded outdoor dining pavilion, a fully equipped outdoor kitchen, and a separate six-car garage block with a staff apartment above. A 500KVA generator, a 100,000-litre water reservoir, and a Crestron smart home system ensure the property operates at full capacity without dependence on public utilities. East Legon's proximity to Kotoka International Airport, the major international schools, and Accra's expanding commercial core makes this one of the most strategically positioned luxury assets in West Africa.
